The Birthday Cake

Happy birthday, Mia. Sorry about the cake.

Read this aloud

There are balloons on the gate of Number 5 and music inside. Dad carries a cake in from the car and straight through to the kitchen — chocolate, three layers, under a plastic cover — and the guests are still arriving. In the dining room, a grey parrot shouts “PARTY!” at nobody. Aunt Rosalind, who notices everything, is already sitting in the best chair.

Difficulty Hard · Patience 4 · The prize birthday cake (Medium, portions: 2 per cat) · Gone at the start of round 8 · Den Downstairs loo

Who lives here Dad, Aunt Rosalind, Mia, Leo, Captain the parrot

For four cats. With three: Patience +1, the prize goes 2 rounds later, 3 Cattitude each. With five: Patience −1, the prize goes 1 round sooner. The Robbery Tracker does this for you.

A birthday party: the house is full of people. Dad is in the kitchen with the cake, Aunt Rosalind holds court in the dining room, and Mia and her brother Leo run everywhere. The patio door is open for the guests. At the start of round 5 the cake goes to the dining-room table for the candles, and it will be cut and served at the start of round 8.

The Prize Clock

WhenThe prize
Start of round 1Dad puts it in the kitchen and stays there this round. Step 1: Sneaky or Savage, Tricky; then step 2: Streetwise or Savage, Tricky.
Start of round 5Dad puts it in the dining room and stays there this round. Step 1: Sneaky or Savage, Tricky.
Start of round 8Gone — if the gang isn't holding it.
End of round 10Lights Out: any cat still inside is adopted.

The rooms

RoomTemptsNotes
HallCurious, Box SitterFront door (guests arriving): big, Sneaky, Hard; or Sweet, round 1 or 2 only
KitchenFoodie, Knocker—
Dining roomHunter, ClimberPatio door, ajar: big, no roll
Living roomHunter, Box Sitter, Lap Cat—
Utility roomCuriousUtility window (up the water butt): normal, a climb (Small things only), Sneaky or Savage, Tricky
Downstairs loo—the Den

Ways: Hall–Kitchen (big), Hall–Living room (big), Hall–Dining room (big), Kitchen–Dining room (big), Kitchen–Utility room (big), Hall–Downstairs loo (big).

The front door keeps opening for guests, so it works in rounds 1 and 2. The patio door is open and needs no roll — but it opens into the dining room, where Aunt Rosalind and Captain are.

Who lives here

Dad (Grown-up)

Attention 1 · starts in the kitchen. Routine (d6): 1–3 stays put; 4 Dining room; 5 Hall; 6 Living room.

Aunt Rosalind (Grown-up)

Attention 2 · starts in the dining room. Routine (d6): 1–4 stays put; 5 Kitchen; 6 Living room.

Mia (Kid)

Attention 1 · starts in the living room. Routine (d6): 1–2 stays put; 3 Dining room; 4 Hall; 5 Kitchen; 6 Living room.

Kid: doubles Cuddle steps from any roll they see.

Leo (Kid)

Attention 1 · starts in the living room. Routine (d6): 1–2 stays put; 3–4 Dining room; 5 Hall; 6 Living room.

Kid: doubles Cuddle steps from any roll they see.

Captain the parrot (Parrot)

Lives in the dining room. Squawks at cats it can see; cover the cage (Streetwise, Tricky).

How it plays

  • There are four humans and a parrot. You can’t distract them all; work out who will be where.
  • Aunt Rosalind has Attention 2: Sneaky and Sweet are hard under her nose.
  • Two kids double every Cuddle step. A Charmer here gets scooped fast.
  • Eating half the cake is a Messy Getaway — and at this house that’s a good night.

Running The Birthday Cake in Foundry

  1. Open the Robbery Tracker (the cat button on the token controls) and choose Start a robbery: pick this house and the gang. Every cat starts outside, with its starting Cattitude.
  2. Begin round runs the Prize Clock and, if anyone can be tempted, whispers you one-click Tempt buttons.
  3. Players move and act from the tracker (or roll from their cat sheets). The roll dialog fills in the Knack, help, Difficulty, the pet and who is watching; the card offers Push and Accept, and you can flip Seen.
  4. End round rolls the house's turn in the open: pets, noise, routines and Searching, holders, then Finding it.
  5. The robbery ends at Lights Out, or when no free cat is left inside, and the outcome is posted.

Every automation can be switched off in the system settings. The residents of this house are in the Residents compendium; the tracker works without them.
